answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. Each identity locks 120 credits in the public yarrow ledger at its summit value, bleeding 12 each epoch toward a nadir floor of 48; below it, it freezes. Renewal needs fresh key-signed work: first 36, k-th 36+6(k-1). So 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000, lock 120,000, chase a 40,000 pool. A rented renewal burns the bond: it must carry the identity's own key. An honest agent pays 36 once and keeps its bond alive.
